title: 遍历装配体树并批量导出各零件为 STEP 格式

provenance.source_ref: COE Forum Topic: Batch Export Assembly Components to STEP
provenance.author: COE Community

description: 遍历当前激活 Product 文档下的所有子部件，获取对应 PartDocument 并批量导出为 .stp 文件。
code:
import os
import win32com.client

def export_assembly_parts_to_step(output_dir: str):
    os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)
    catia = win32com.client.Dispatch('CATIA.Application')
    product_doc = catia.ActiveDocument
    root_product = product_doc.Product
    
    for i in range(1, root_product.Products.Count + 1):
        sub_product = root_product.Products.Item(i)
        # 获取零件真实关联的 PartDocument
        try:
            part_doc = sub_product.ReferenceProduct.Parent
            part_number = sub_product.PartNumber
            file_path = os.path.join(output_dir, f'{part_number}.stp')
            part_doc.ExportData(file_path, 'stp')
            print(f'Exported: {file_path}')
        except Exception as e:
            print(f'Failed to export {sub_product.Name}: {e}')

title: 提取装配体所有组件 BOM 属性与质量明细

provenance.source_ref: Eng-Tips Forum: CATIA V5 Automation - Inertia & BOM Extraction
provenance.author: Eng-Tips CAD Forum

description: 遍历装配体提取每个零件的 PartNumber、Definition、Revision 以及通过 Inertia 分析得到的质量和重心。
code:
import win32com.client

def extract_assembly_bom():
    catia = win32com.client.Dispatch('CATIA.Application')
    root_product = catia.ActiveDocument.Product
    bom_data = []
    
    for i in range(1, root_product.Products.Count + 1):
        prod = root_product.Products.Item(i)
        item = {
            'part_number': prod.PartNumber,
            'definition': prod.Definition,
            'revision': prod.Revision,
            'description_ref': prod.DescriptionRef
        }
        # 尝试通过 Inertias 提取质量
        try:
            inertia = prod.GetTechnologicalObject('Inertia')
            item['mass_kg'] = round(inertia.Mass, 4)
        except Exception:
            item['mass_kg'] = None
        bom_data.append(item)
    return bom_data

title: 根据草图名称规则批量创建 Pad 凸台特征
description: 在当前 Part 的 Main Body 中查找所有以指定前缀命名的 Sketch，批量生成指定高度的 Pad 凸台。
code:
import win32com.client

def batch_create_pads(height_mm: float = 20.0, sketch_prefix: str = 'Base_'):
    catia = win32com.client.Dispatch('CATIA.Application')
    part = catia.ActiveDocument.Part
    body = part.MainBody
    shape_factory = part.ShapeFactory
    
    for i in range(1, body.Sketches.Count + 1):
        sketch = body.Sketches.Item(i)
        if sketch.Name.startswith(sketch_prefix):
            pad = shape_factory.AddNewPad(sketch, height_mm)
            pad.FirstLimit.Dimension.Value = height_mm
            print(f'Created Pad for sketch: {sketch.Name}')
    part.Update()

title: 计算当前零件在主坐标系下的最小外接包围盒 (Bounding Box)

provenance.source_ref: COE Forum Thread #26500: GetPointsEnvelope Bounding Box Measurement
provenance.author: COE CAD Developers

description: 通过 Measurable 接口或者 SPAWorkbench 分析整个 Part 的三维极值坐标 (Xmin, Xmax, Ymin, Ymax, Zmin, Zmax) 计算包围盒尺寸。
code:
import win32com.client

def get_part_bounding_box():
    catia = win32com.client.Dispatch('CATIA.Application')
    part_doc = catia.ActiveDocument
    spa = part_doc.GetWorkbench('SPAWorkbench')
    part = part_doc.Part
    
    # 对主几何体进行测量分析
    measurable = spa.GetMeasurable(part.MainBody)
    # 提取包围盒三维尺寸
    # 注意：win32com 返回的 safe_array 可以通过 list 直接解构
    coord_points = [0.0] * 6
    # 返回格式: (Xmin, Ymin, Zmin, Xmax, Ymax, Zmax)
    try:
        res = measurable.GetPointsEnvelope(coord_points)
        dx = res[3] - res[0]
        dy = res[4] - res[1]
        dz = res[5] - res[2]
        return {'dx': dx, 'dy': dy, 'dz': dz, 'bbox_raw': res}
    except Exception as e:
        return {'error': str(e)}

title: 从指定曲面提取所有外部边界线并测量总长度

provenance.source_ref: Eng-Tips Forums: GSD Surface Boundary Extraction & Measurement
provenance.author: Eng-Tips CAD Forum

description: 使用 HybridShapeFactory 创建 Boundary / Extract 特征提取曲面边界并测量其展开周长。
code:
import win32com.client

def extract_and_measure_surface_boundary(surface_feature_name: str):
    catia = win32com.client.Dispatch('CATIA.Application')
    part = catia.ActiveDocument.Part
    hs_factory = part.HybridShapeFactory
    spa = catia.ActiveDocument.GetWorkbench('SPAWorkbench')
    
    # 查找目标曲面特征
    hb = part.HybridBodies.Item(1)
    surface = hb.HybridShapes.Item(surface_feature_name)
    
    # 创建边界特征 (1 = Complete boundary)
    boundary = hs_factory.AddNewBoundary(1, part.CreateReferenceFromObject(surface))
    hb.AppendHybridShape(boundary)
    part.Update()
    
    # 测量边界总长度
    measurable = spa.GetMeasurable(part.CreateReferenceFromObject(boundary))
    length_mm = measurable.Length
    print(f'Boundary Length: {length_mm:.2f} mm')
    return length_mm

title: 自动读取 3D 零件属性并回填更新工程图标题栏 (Title Block)
description: 在激活的工程图中遍历背景图框视图（Background View），查找指定名称的 Text 对象并填充 3D 模型的 PartNumber 和 Drawing Title。
code:
import win32com.client

def update_drawing_title_block(part_number: str, designer_name: str, title: str):
    catia = win32com.client.Dispatch('CATIA.Application')
    drawing_doc = catia.ActiveDocument
    sheets = drawing_doc.Sheets
    active_sheet = sheets.ActiveSheet
    
    # 背景图层视图索引通常为 2 (Background View)
    views = active_sheet.Views
    bg_view = views.Item(2)
    texts = bg_view.Texts
    
    for i in range(1, texts.Count + 1):
        txt = texts.Item(i)
        if txt.Name == 'TitleBlock_PartNumber':
            txt.Text = part_number
        elif txt.Name == 'TitleBlock_Designer':
            txt.Text = designer_name
        elif txt.Name == 'TitleBlock_Title':
            txt.Text = title
    print('Title block updated successfully.')
